# shelve.games

> A personal journal of every game you've played and every game you're waiting for. Sign up, search a game, and set its Status (Played, Playing, Backlog or Wishlist). Your Library collects them, your Wishlist counts down to releases, and your Stats add them up.

Game data is provided by IGDB (https://www.igdb.com).

## Public pages

- [Home](https://shelve.games/): search the catalog and see how a Journal starts.
- [Game pages](https://shelve.games/games/): one page per game at `/games/{slug}`, with the summary, platforms, genres, critic and user scores, and every known regional release date. Listed in the sitemap.
- [Public profiles](https://shelve.games/u/): a member's Library, Wishlist and Stats at `/u/{username}`. Private notes are never shown.
- [Sitemap](https://shelve.games/sitemap.xml)

## Not available to crawlers

A member's own Library, Wishlist, Stats, Settings and calendar feed are behind a sign-in and are disallowed in robots.txt. Playthrough notes are private and never appear on a public page or in an API response.
